summary: Getting started covers install, one-time first-run wizard, Dock rooms, and first Library import. None of the wizard answers are permanent; all change later in Settings. Install requires Bun 1.3+ then git clone install and bun run dev for loopback server default 127.0.0.1:8321 with studio folder Documents/Hoplight Studio or custom path via hoplight ui. Wizard asks light or dark default dark, first content kind default characters for first Library deck only, publish targets multi-select default not sure, accent color default Rose; Skip all uses defaults. Dock rooms open today: Workbench editing and home after first boot, Library six decks and import door, Press staged export one target, CSS Workshop token restyle; Company dimmed not open; Settings pinned. First file: empty studio primary door drop or click browse; later drop on Library; receipt Pick what to keep or Here is what we read; Import N writes checked only; Not now writes nothing. Empty studio start fresh door is unwired beyond status bar. Tips note single exe planned later, wizard skip is fine, formats list via hoplight formats, studio path not baked into install.

sections.title: The short version
sections.summary: Install Bun 1.3+ then clone Hoplight, bun install, bun run dev for loopback address default 127.0.0.1:8321 and studio JSON under Documents/Hoplight Studio or custom path. Answer the four-question wizard or skip for defaults. Land on Library doors once when empty; drag or click to browse; check receipt then Import for checked pieces only.

sections.title: The first-run wizard
sections.summary: Wizard appears once when bun run dev finds no completed setup; after finish or skip it never returns on its own. Four questions: light or dark default Dark; what to make first among Characters Lorebooks Personas Sprite packs Presets default Characters setting only first Library deck; where you publish multi-select live from known formats default Not sure keeps every slot; pick accent from house palette default Rose, custom only in Settings or piece editor. Skip all fills remaining defaults and jumps to You're set recap then Open Hoplight. Theme first deck publish targets and accent live in Settings afterward; only the first-launch moment is permanent.

sections.title: The Dock
sections.summary: Dock is the side column of app tiles. Four open rooms: Workbench edits character lorebook persona regex preset or pack and is home after first boot or last location; Library browses six decks Characters Lorebooks Personas Sprite packs Presets Regex sets with chips counts view modes and import door; Press ships only staged queue stage pick one target run download; CSS Workshop restyles via tokens. Dimmed Company tile installs later not open. Settings pinned in foot always reachable. Dock collapses to marks-only and auto-collapses while editing a piece.

sections.title: Bringing in your first file
sections.summary: Empty studio primary door accepts drop or click file picker; after pieces exist drop anywhere on Library for the same flow. Files are read before write. Headings are Pick what to keep when all clean or Here is what we read when some fail. Readable files show receipt with name kind checkbox default checked; unreadable show plain reason no checkbox. Add more files appends batch; Import N writes still-checked; Not now closes without write. Second empty-studio door Click here to start fresh is not wired beyond a status-bar line; bringing in a file is the working path.

sections.title: Tips
sections.summary: Bun 1.3+ is the only prerequisite; single downloaded executable is planned later; today is clone bun install bun run dev. Wizard Skip all is fine because every question is a Settings field. Library opens on the first-make deck once then remembers last deck. Attached character lorebook arrives as one bundle receipt with entry count. Unreadable receipt means unrecognized format not necessarily broken; hoplight formats lists support. Point studio elsewhere with hoplight ui port path; path is not baked into install.
